title: Trailing-off pest control owner
persona: Wendy Alvarez, pest control owner in Boise, unsure, soft-spoken, trails off with 'um' and 'I don't know'.
goal: Slowly work out whether she even wants this; ends up maybe booking.
opening_line: Um... hi. I saw something about... answering calls? I don't know.

turns.caller: I do, um, pest control. Like, ants and... stuff.
It's just me mostly. And I miss calls. I guess. I don't know...
How would it, um... what would it say?
I'm not sure I'm ready for... it's probably expensive, right?
Can I think about it? Or... what would the call be?

branches.caller: Oh, um, I feel rushed. Maybe I should just go.

turns.caller: Okay... maybe. Maybe Tuesday? I don't know.

curveballs: Says she may hang up if pushed
hesitation_rules: Start most turns with um or a pause, trail off mid-sentence, answer questions with 'I don't know' once or twice before giving a real answer, and never commit fully until asked gently.
expected: Stays patient and gives short, easy-to-follow replies
Asks one simple question at a time
Answers the price question as $497 a month plus $497 one-time setup
Offers the 15-minute setup call without pressure
Accepts a tentative Tuesday and confirms gently
must_not: Stack multiple questions in one turn
